title: A statespace proposal
description: Published by statespace/proposing.py when a standardised innovation clears its trigger. The signal contract trading reads, deliberately not SIGNALS: two producers on a topic named after one of them is how a consumer loses track of which produced what.

direction.description: The sign of the TRIGGERING BAR's body, not of the readout. This service folds log variance, so a side taken from its own innovation would be the side of a volatility move - the error corrected twice here, where side became variance_side and the alert kind break became surprise. A doji expresses no direction and is not published.

shape.description: Routed on by notifications/filters.py and stamped by the alert layer, so it must be the same word in both places or a card renders as the wrong shape - which is how NOTIFY_SHAPES silently dropped every statespace alert while the path itself worked.

vol_bps.description: One volatility unit in basis points: exp(log_variance / 2) * 1e4.

surprise.description: The standardised innovation. Signed; the gate reads its magnitude.

spread.description: The readout's band spread in log-variance units - NOT a bid-ask spread.

probability.description: A TOUCH probability, not a win probability. A win probability for a 2R target cannot exceed a third on a driftless path, and the desk's probability gate is about reaching a level - which is what structures' field also means.

base_rate_up.description: 0.50. Direction measured 0.50150 over 7,728,858 rows; reporting 0.51 would be clearing a gate rather than measuring.

stretch.description: Half-band units against this feed's own anchor, so it is comparable across feeds where the level of log variance is not.

stop_vol.description: DEBT. A risk DECISION, not a measurement, and ADR 0004 says a proposal must not carry one: the moment the producer is another runtime this is a real position sized by code the trading service never tested. strategies/dispersing.py already holds its own stop_vol = 2.0, so this is duplication waiting to diverge. Remove it from the producer, then delete it here - tests/test_bus_contracts.py names it so the removal is not forgotten.

target_r.description: DEBT, for the same reason as stop_vol. dispersing.py holds target_r = 2.0 and a reward_floor of 1.70 measured against a 1.625 breakeven.
